description: Mediation Board Commission - Appointment of Mediators to District of Kalutara, Kandy and Matale etc.,
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the appointment of mediators to specific Mediation Boards in the Kaluthara District, made by the Mediation Boards Commission under the authority of the Mediation Boards Act. This falls under judicial administration and the appointment of officials to a quasi-judicial dispute resolution body, making it a clear fit for the Judicial/Law Enforcement category (Type 9).
